title: Plov
instructions: Heat the oil over high flame; add the onions and sauté for about 5-7 minutes, until soft and slightly browned.

Add the lamb and chicken and stir for about 5 minutes (add 1 tsp of the plof spice). Add a handful of carrots and stir several times, then add 2 cups of water, the rest of the carrots, 2 tsp plof spice, 1 tsp zeera, 2 tsp salt, and pepper. Boil, then lower the flame, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.

Wash the rice, add 1½ tbsp of salt, and leave in water for 15 minutes. Drain the rice and add it to the pot over high flame with 1 cup of water. Boil and mix — make holes and mix (do this many times), pulling the rice in from the sides, until the water level decreases.
Lower the flame to 2, cover with aluminum foil and then the lid, and cook for 15 minutes. Mix up the rice, then cover for another 10-15 minutes.
notes: '3 chicken — without shin' interpreted as chicken without skin; the cut of chicken and amount of lamb are not specified.
